scope: Static pre-execution review of the bounded basket-lead information plan, source-card summaries and manifests, timing helper, project contract, and official Qlib documentation. No 2024 or 2025 feature arrays, labels, fit outputs, Recorder objects, or accounts were opened; no fit, bootstrap, notebook, or test was run.
pre_execution_formula_repair: The fixed candidate now takes log1p of the full 30-member normalized weighted simple-return basket and subtracts the SOXX first-hour log return. With two equal-weight stocks returning +10% and -10%, the fixed-dollar arithmetic basket and perfectly tracking ETF each return zero, so new x=0; the former weighted-log basket would be 0.5*ln(1.1)+0.5*ln(0.9)=0.5*ln(0.99)<0. The revision removes this mechanical dispersion residual before any candidate outcomes were read. It remains an opening-dollar-weight proxy, not NAV or actual holding replication.
positive_checks: The source card reports 502 complete, valid 2024-2025 basket sessions and pins its Futu NONE Qlib provider and source Recorder; this is source qualification, not candidate information evidence.

The factor uses all 30 SEC-disclosed equities with filing_date strictly before each session, whole-basket weights, and full observed 5-minute endpoints; SOXX 1-minute control and forward label clocks are separated.

The 2024 fit and sealed freeze receipt precede all 2025 numeric price/label reads and 2025 weight Dataset construction. B/C use identical complete dates, a fixed positive sign, exactly two fits, and zero accounts. Both years remain reused history and the 10:31 availability delay is an assumption, not certified first receipt.
The Box et al. paper supports examining constituent-to-ETF information flow; it does not establish this SOXX horizon, delayed execution, or a fee-net edge. The plan limits its claim accordingly.
The candidate is a price residual using constituent returns, separate from the closed P3 path-area account route and the earlier breadth/rotation descriptors; P3 remains closed.

The plan uses the already-qualified SEC holdings CSV only to ingest phase-filtered PIT metadata into native DatasetH/DataHandlerLP, with 2025 retaining eligible prior-2025 filings. It explicitly excludes the older PIT provider's incomplete membership because it omits WOLF, an active 2024 constituent.

All currently relevant price-provider manifests, calendars, instrument lists, and exact feature-bin bytes are pinned as present-day snapshots; these hashes do not establish historical first receipt or an immutable vintage.

The fixed information gate requires fitted 2024 gamma > 0, positive 2025 mean paired MSE improvement, and a positive one-sided stationary-bootstrap lower quantile at alpha=.025/15 with mean block 63 sessions, 10000 replicates, and seed 20261014. Pearson contribution correlation is diagnostic only.

The sole pre-execution formula repair changes weighted constituent log returns to the log of the normalized weighted simple-return basket. It prevents a Jensen/dispersion residual under perfect arithmetic-basket tracking; the plan records the former accepted hash as superseded before execution and prohibits a parallel geometric candidate.

Execution requires Qlib native calendars and bounded D.features reads by year, separate phase DatasetH/DataHandlerLP objects, and a new R Recorder for freeze and evaluation evidence. Pre-existing Recorder reads are excluded; new Recorder readback is allowed.
execution_boundary: This accepts a static, frozen design only. Before execution, verify each pinned source byte hash and the full 30-member WOLF-aware PIT construction; failure means needs_data, with no partial basket repair. This review has not run the notebook or certified a scientific outcome. An information pass remains diagnostic and cannot establish an independently validated, fee-net SOXX account.
